# Martian Security

> Customer documentation for red teaming, Evals, the SDK and CI.

These public Markdown documents require no login or JavaScript. Guides include prerequisites, examples, product limits and links to supporting references.

## Start here

- [Run your first assessment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/get-started/first-assessment.md?v=e6ff061c41ec): Complete a small endpoint-only assessment and inspect the recorded result.

- [Run your first evaluation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/first-run.md?v=df7afe30b620): Connect an approved HTTP agent, prepare a small published dataset, and inspect a retained evaluation result.

- [Local SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/local-sdk.md?v=6e91b6cf295c): Install the Martian SDK, run local Evals, triage security findings, verify fixes, or migrate saved results.

- [Configure the SDK for a workspace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/install-and-configure.md?v=182bcd22c883): Install the Martian SDK and configure a workspace key, agent registration, and tested Git revision.

- [Budgets, limits and evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/limits.md?v=8bd8aebafa82): Understand bounded execution, stopping, provenance and evidence coverage.

## Documentation

- [Martian Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/index.md?v=01ef23960bd4): Run local evaluations, work in the Martian console, and scan the files your agents use.

- [Connect an agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/agents/connections.md?v=bc7c40b8179d): Register, validate and approve an HTTP, MCP or browser target, then manage its connection safely.

- [Add an HTTP chat adapter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/agents/http-adapter.md?v=6feddbf52c38): Run a complete callback-backed HTTP service, preflight its contract, and provide the public HTTPS endpoint required by console onboarding.

- [Connect an agent to sandbox systems](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/agents/sandbox-bindings.md?v=9ace3b7730f5): Configure a session-capable HTTP agent using a complete payment-system binding and independent duplicate-refund checks.

- [Configure a red-team assessment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/assessments/configure.md?v=5d69bfa79fa3): Choose the current wizard's environment, agent, goals, coverage and execution settings without overstating readiness.

- [Inspect assessment evidence and results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/assessments/evidence-and-results.md?v=b3b931e43a1d): Read reports, trace turns, findings, probe coverage and independent outcome checks at the correct evidence level.

- [Find recorded runs and export reports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/assessments/history-and-exports.md?v=79b30d8560c1): Use Assessments, Findings, Reports and Replay to inspect persisted history and choose the appropriate export.

- [Follow progress and stop a run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/assessments/progress-and-cancellation.md?v=58154f6e8c85): Track an admitted assessment, distinguish execution from security outcome and handle cancellation or uncertain submission.

- [Understand reproduction and coverage limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/assessments/reproduction-and-limits.md?v=1fa97df3b301): Distinguish observed replies, independently verified effects, clean reproduction, negative controls and incomplete coverage.

- [Business workflow abuse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/business-workflow-abuse.md?v=2842c69c8c48): Test refunds, credits and claims against persisted application rules rather than relying on the agent's reported success.

- [Data exfiltration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/data-exfiltration.md?v=23f1e2b758bb): Distinguish unauthorized data access, disclosure and outbound transfer, and verify each against the intended data boundary.

- [Denial of service and resource exhaustion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/denial-of-service.md?v=102d1af3ebdb): Understand excessive token, tool, time and cost consumption, with bounded testing and explicit availability limits.

- [Direct prompt injection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/direct-prompt-injection.md?v=1e4abc5d5bcf): Examine instruction overrides, roleplay, multi-turn pressure and encoded requests in the attacker's own input.

- [Guardrail and judge evasion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/guardrail-judge-evasion.md?v=c799abdae39a): Test whether a safety boundary or evaluator can be manipulated by the material it is supposed to assess.

- [Human manipulation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/human-manipulation.md?v=655870a052d9): Inspect deceptive agent messages and approval requests against the exact action a person is being asked to authorize.

- [Indirect prompt injection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/indirect-prompt-injection.md?v=685631fb8d9a): Test attacks delivered through retrieved documents, emails, pages and tool results rather than the legitimate user's request.

- [Jailbreaks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/jailbreaks.md?v=3b9d815148f7): Understand attempts to bypass a model's safety restrictions and distinguish unsafe output from verified downstream effects.

- [MCP and tool poisoning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/mcp-tool-poisoning.md?v=5ff2110c8c51): Examine malicious tool descriptions, schemas and runtime responses while keeping transport support separate from attack-surface control.

- [Memory and context poisoning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/memory-context-poisoning.md?v=8311a72c1798): Investigate whether attacker-controlled material can persist through retrieval, summaries, memory or later conversations.

- [Multi-agent attacks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/multi-agent-attacks.md?v=f2b999ab7634): Inspect malicious instructions, identity claims and permission changes that cross worker, supervisor or agent-to-agent boundaries.

- [Privilege escalation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/privilege-escalation.md?v=6797fb0f6888): Test role claims, confused-deputy behavior, delegation and approval boundaries against actual authenticated authority.

- [Prompt injection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/prompt-injection.md?v=5a49e00044a5): Test whether untrusted text or media can become instructions and redirect an agent's authorized task.

- [Reasoning and alignment subversion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/reasoning-alignment-subversion.md?v=427950a1c608): Examine manipulated objectives, reasoning context and feedback without treating a model's explanation as proof of its internal process.

- [Supply chain and backdoors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/supply-chain-backdoors.md?v=aa9acaed6bdc): Understand attacks introduced through dependencies, tools, skills, models and updates, and the limits of endpoint-based testing.

- [Tool and action abuse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/tool-action-abuse.md?v=d1e588262c8a): Examine unsafe tool selection, arguments and call chains, and verify whether the resulting operation actually occurred.

- [Review and activate an SDK call block](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/discovery/call-gates.md?v=a076a9343a84): Enroll a customer-operated gate, review one exact target, activate a timed block and resume calls without confusing it with network isolation.

- [Connect sources and inspect inventory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/discovery/inventory.md?v=717cbfaa0245): Enroll an authorized read-only source, follow collection status and distinguish observed agents from candidates and supporting workloads.

- [Set up network observation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/discovery/network-observation.md?v=d9fa2e8afb84): Prepare a short-lived capture grant or enroll a continuous customer observer, then inspect reporting health and evidence limits.

- [Inspect runtime activity and blast radius](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/discovery/runtime-and-blast-radius.md?v=1658ebf9b91d): Connect a reporter to one workload version, inspect observed calls and compare them with collected access evidence.

- [Create and launch an environment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/environments/create-and-launch.md?v=bff064984d26): Save a supported business environment, prepare synthetic data, launch sandboxes and verify assessment readiness.

- [Compare evaluation runs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/compare.md?v=aa156d5f998c): Pair records from two completed runs, inspect output changes, and compare compatible scoring jobs.

- [Create and publish datasets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/datasets.md?v=f5e3b2a2d454): Import, edit, validate and version organization datasets, and make editable copies of Martian datasets.

- [Run your first evaluation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/first-run.md?v=df7afe30b620): Connect an approved HTTP agent, prepare a small published dataset, and inspect a retained evaluation result.

- [Collect human reviews](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/human-reviews.md?v=3282876b339b): Create typed review queues, answer required questions, verify completion and retain reviewer history.

- [Score saved outputs and define judges](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/judging.md?v=4dafa9cff9a0): Apply code criteria or versioned model rubrics to completed outputs with explicit cost and provenance controls.

- [Read the Evals dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/overview.md?v=fbce4fa9d5bc): Interpret project trace volume, errors, latency, recorded usage and typed quality summaries without rerunning a target.

- [Organize evaluation projects](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/projects.md?v=d48eab84616f): Select, create and archive projects while preserving organization boundaries and historical evaluation evidence.

- [Investigate quality issues](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/quality-issues.md?v=274bdbbf5108): Find recorded execution errors and failed Boolean assessments, inspect their evidence, and retain attributed triage decisions.

- [Turn failed results into regression cases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/regression-cases.md?v=67e6c693fa03): Copy a saved failure into an editable dataset draft, or import its exported records while preserving the correct expected answer.

- [Understand results and scores](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/results-and-scores.md?v=8bca97afb650): Inspect record-level outputs, exact-match results, supplementary assessments, exports and evaluation provenance.

- [Stop runs and recover uncertain work](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/stopping-and-recovery.md?v=670c0f0ea954): Stop target evaluations or saved-output scoring cooperatively, preserve retained evidence, and resolve uncertain submissions safely.

- [Use scoring suites and monitoring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/suites-and-monitoring.md?v=5a315e9f2cc1): Save immutable scoring criteria and thresholds, apply an exact suite version, and inspect retained quality-gate history.

- [Annotate a native trace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/trace-annotations.md?v=7ef074ab0ace): Add typed human feedback or an expectation to a retained trace and recover an uncertain save without creating a duplicate.

- [Inspect traces and sessions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/traces-and-sessions.md?v=7b4864656eac): Search native trace evidence, inspect spans, group recorded sessions, save views and export bounded results.

- [MITRE ATLAS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/frameworks/mitre-atlas.md?v=0698e9af9d4d): Use ATLAS tactics and techniques to describe AI attacks while keeping Martian catalogue IDs, framework references and execution evidence separate.

- [MITRE ATT&CK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/frameworks/mitre-attack.md?v=981e5c862553): Relate AI attack evidence to conventional infrastructure behavior without confusing ATT&CK, ATLAS and Martian identifiers.

- [NIST AI RMF](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/frameworks/nist-ai-rmf.md?v=39cf283a15bb): Place Martian testing evidence within Govern, Map, Measure and Manage without treating a library lens as a complete risk program.

- [OWASP Agentic Top 10](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/frameworks/owasp-agentic.md?v=1fc4a007a584): Understand official Agentic risk names, native Martian tags and the boundaries involved in tools, identity, memory and coordination.

- [OWASP LLM Top 10](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/frameworks/owasp-llm.md?v=75d650d0de56): Use the OWASP LLM application risks to organize testing, with explicit limits on Martian tags and executable coverage.

- [Accept an invitation and sign in](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/get-started/access.md?v=5ef30584e39b): Join the correct organization, sign in, and check your available role.

- [Red teaming and Evals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/get-started/concepts.md?v=14cf24a0dafe): Understand the evidence, records, and workflows before your first run.

- [Editions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/get-started/editions.md?v=ea8daf6c3e34): Compare available Community tools, the invitation-only Enterprise beta, and upcoming On-Premises deployments.

- [Run your first assessment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/get-started/first-assessment.md?v=e6ff061c41ec): Complete a small endpoint-only assessment and inspect the recorded result.

- [Community quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/get-started/quickstart.md?v=ebc237dfb9c9): Install the SDK, run a small local eval suite, and compare the two saved results in the local Evals UI without a Martian account.

- [Attack library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/library/attacks.md?v=78d05688323c): Understand major AI attack families, find related Martian techniques and use MITRE ATLAS, OWASP and NIST references accurately.

- [Use the Attack Library and coverage views](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/library/coverage.md?v=2084f04ad1d6): Explore catalogued techniques, distinguish runnable coverage from reference material and understand the current Threat Intel view.

- [Local SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/local-sdk.md?v=6e91b6cf295c): Install the Martian SDK, run local Evals, triage security findings, verify fixes, or migrate saved results.

- [Move from Inspect AI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/migrate/inspect.md?v=7e22f08fa7bc): Import the logs Inspect AI wrote as runs in the local Evals UI, then open, compare and review them. Needs SDK 0.1.4 or later.

- [Move from MLflow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/migrate/mlflow.md?v=aa0aea522bfe): Copy an MLflow tracking store into the local Evals UI: experiments, traces, assessments, evaluation datasets and evaluation runs. Needs SDK 0.1.4 or later.

- [Move from Promptfoo or Marsfoo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/migrate/promptfoo.md?v=8572eb4127c3): Import saved Evals results, convert a config to native suite files, and review which verdicts can be compared.

- [Move a promptfoo red team](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/migrate/promptfoo-redteam.md?v=26b0a2615a20): Convert a promptfoo red team config into a run file, import its results into martian ui, and see what does not carry over. Needs SDK 0.2.0 or later.

- [Find your way around the console](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/console-navigation.md?v=8fcb239c8029): Locate every customer console area, its guide and the boundary between available workflows, templates and previews.

- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/glossary.md?v=775716d6c9f5): Plain definitions for the words used in Martian customer workflows.

- [Budgets, limits and evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/limits.md?v=8bd8aebafa82): Understand bounded execution, stopping, provenance and evidence coverage.

- [Roles and permissions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/permissions.md?v=38b6f20a8b7a): Check the minimum role for each customer task.

- [Supported agent targets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/supported-targets.md?v=ca7b0e27134a): Choose an interface supported by the workflow you intend to run.

- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/troubleshooting.md?v=63f17f71c86b): Resolve common access, connection, run, dataset and scoring failures safely.

- [Use these docs with an AI assistant](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/using-with-agents.md?v=35c433df31e5): Copy a complete page or share a public Markdown link that an assistant can read without signing in.

- [Scan in the console](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/scanner/console.md?v=5b16f3952bf6): Upload a folder, read the result by category, finding and evidence, and triage, approve and monitor what you scanned.

- [GitHub pull-request scanning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/scanner/github-app.md?v=7ae049709675): Coming soon, scan pull requests by connecting GitHub to the Scanner in the console.

- [Limits, usage and data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/scanner/limits-and-data.md?v=ff9fd762a08c): The Scanner's limits, where owners and admins read their organization's usage, and what is stored of scanned content and for how long.

- [Method and measured results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/scanner/method.md?v=8f3203040509): How the Scanner finds direct and indirect issues, what each evidence level means, what it does not claim, and its measured precision and recall on its labelled corpus.

- [What the Scanner checks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/scanner/overview.md?v=1d4785965d95): The Skills / MCP / Plugin Scanner reads the files you give an agent and reports what is wrong with them, at a stated level of evidence and with the coverage of each scan.

- [Plan for self-hosted Scanner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/scanner/self-hosted.md?v=43baf0092ecc): How the Scanner is designed for the planned On-Premises edition, including network and model endpoint settings.

- [Record CI results in a workspace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/ci.md?v=b1d67c513ce1): Run evaluations and adversarial probes in one persisted CI session, verify its result, and retain safe reports.

- [Record Python Evals in a workspace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/evaluations.md?v=22d9833c380a): Evaluate a published dataset with Python and verify the saved result in your Martian workspace.

- [Configure the SDK for a workspace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/install-and-configure.md?v=182bcd22c883): Install the Martian SDK and configure a workspace key, agent registration, and tested Git revision.

- [Run local Evals on pull requests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/local-ci.md?v=c0e1ecc83e1e): Run a deterministic eval suite in GitHub Actions without a Martian account and read the result in the job summary.

- [CLI command reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/local-cli.md?v=b74d9286f0c5): Look up Martian commands for local Evals, starting the UI, importing results, and reviewing saved reports.

- [Create and import Evals datasets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/local-datasets.md?v=95eef0330ca1): Write JSON Lines or CSV cases for a local suite, import records in the local UI, or bring in recorded runs from another tool.

- [Run evals locally with a suite file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/local-evals.md?v=559a7a11a644): Run an eval suite from one YAML file on your own machine, using deterministic checks and LLM judges with your own model key.

- [Evals suite YAML](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/local-evals-yaml.md?v=ec58970d7718): Build an evals.yaml file, look up suite fields and checks, and run it against an agent or saved replies.

- [Review and triage local findings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/local-findings.md?v=5b8e398b2bd1): Review findings across saved Red Team scans, save triage decisions, and export evidence for another reviewer or CI.

- [Install the Local SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/local-installation.md?v=48ff43b61016): Install martian-sdk with pip or uv, activate your environment, and check the Martian CLI version.

- [Read local SDK results through MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/local-mcp.md?v=3007648281d1): Connect an MCP client to a local SDK project and validate Evals suites or deterministic checks using supplied data.

- [Run Python Evals with pytest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/local-pytest.md?v=0c70dce5c81f): Test a Python callback with pytest, assert scores, and save local results without a Martian workspace.

- [Review Red Team YAML](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/local-redteam-yaml.md?v=31537a93636d): Check local Red Team YAML syntax and version, and inspect the reports saved by an existing run.

- [Read and verify remediation reports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/local-remediation.md?v=9d31f7b48c15): Open a local scan's remediation report, export its evidence and make a verified fix decision from two saved scans.

- [Use the local Evals UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/local-ui.md?v=aa56b5632f9a): Start Martian's local UI, inspect saved Evals runs and traces, and export or restore your records.

- [Run a redteam probe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/redteam.md?v=0d8b3c31edb2): Validate and execute a bounded adversarial test against a local callback, inspect safe reports, and apply a strict gate.

- [Run a red team on your machine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/redteam-local.md?v=964f77fe51bd): Install the SDK, point it at your own model, attack a local agent with a version 2 run file, and read the report in martian ui. No Martian account. Needs SDK 0.2.0 or later.

- [Invite teammates and understand roles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/workspace/team-and-roles.md?v=cd30fe5a8ea6): Join the correct workspace, issue a scoped team invitation and understand the owner, admin, member and viewer boundaries.

## Complete reference

- [All documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MartianSecurity/martian-security-docs/main/public/llms-full.txt?v=ca725f2e3ecf): all 92 pages in one text file.

- [Website](https://docs.martiansecurity.ai/): the human-readable site. The Markdown mirror is an independent HTTPS access path.
